context:
Goal: review only as much as a change needs, as you asked at 21:43 CST ("if something passed in round 1 why does it have mandatory follow up rounds").
Problem (rule): open PR #2252 makes every guard or check change wait for round 3 and a net-value test, even after a round 1 PASS. That goes past your earlier ruling, so it needs your word.
Based on (record): the review-record decision (how a PR's review is recorded) calls a round 1 or round 2 PASS done for any change.
Based on (ruling): on Nov 8 at 06:08 CST you ruled that a guard change fixed under a fix check still gets round 3, because a fix check reads only the fix.
Departs from: main reads a guard change done after a round 1 or 2 PASS or a fix check PASS — only a fix check PASS waits for round 3 (a), or every guard change waits for round 3 (b).
Meanwhile: three lanes hold their round 3; they wait on the current batch anyway.

options.gain: A clean PASS merges with no extra round, and a fixed guard change still gets the full safety read.
options.how: Narrow PR #2252 to your Nov 8 ruling: only a guard change fixed under a fix check waits for round 3.
options.label: Round 3 only after a fix check
options.lose: A guard change that passes round 1 gets no net-value test.

options.gain: Every guard or check change gets a net-value judgement.
options.label: Every guard change waits for round 3
options.lose: One extra Sonnet review round for each guard or check change.

ref: step review-state-guard-needs-round-3; PR #2252; your chat words 21:43 CST Nov 9; lanes #2488, #2489 and #2493 hold round 3 meanwhile
reply: Routed 23:39 CST to the coordinator: a, narrow #2252 so only a guard change fixed under a fix check waits for round 3. Your note on the net-value test went with it. Home: step review-state-guard-needs-round-3.
title: Should a guard or check change that passes review round 1 still wait for round 3?
